'''Game Breaker''' is a {{Special}} item rewarded to players who have reported a game-breaking exploit in Hypixel SkyBlock. Some of these reports include dupe glitches, server crashing methods, or skill abuse.

'''{{red|Take note that if you abuse a bug and then report it to the admins, you may not receive a Game Breaker and you may get banned!}}'''

== Obtaining ==
'''Game Breakers''' can sometimes be obtained by reporting a game-breaking exploit.

== Trivia ==
* In late May 2020, {{RN|Admin|Jayavarmen}} announced that he would give a '''Game Breaker''' to the first person that reported a bug with the [[Wardrobe]] on the Alpha Hypixel Network.
